notablePrerequisites:
You have a green creature card in hand with mana value equal to seven.
Viridian Joiner does not have summoning sickness.
You have enough mana to cast the creature card in hand, minus {1}.
description:
Activate Viridian Joiner by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} equal to Viridian Joiner's power.
Cast any creature card in your hand with mana value seven by paying its mana cost.
Raggadragga's second ability triggers, untapping Viridian Joiner and giving it +7/+7 until end of turn.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning the green creature with mana value seven from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
